inline.headline: Before the hammer, a plan.
inline.text: Snap the wall in Jib and it lists what to check first: the engineer's sign-off, the asbestos test, and the electrician for the power point that's in the way.
inline.alt: A structural engineer and a couple standing at a hallway wall in an older home, the engineer pointing up at the ceiling line while their toddler watches from the doorway

jobs.title: Remove the wall between kitchen and lounge
jobs.description: Plasterboard stud wall, 1970s house. Power point on the kitchen side.

shoppingList.item: Electrician: remove power point and make safe

directions: Book the engineer to confirm it's not load bearing
Have the wall lining tested for asbestos
Get the electrician to disconnect the power point
Then strip linings and remove the studs

jobs.title: Patch the ceiling where the wall was

end.headline: One wall down. One big room.
end.alt: A family eating breakfast together at a kitchen bench in a bright, newly opened-up kitchen and living area

jobs.title: Patch and paint after the wall removal
jobs.description: Fill the ceiling and wall joins, new cornice, then two coats.
directions: Screw new plasterboard strips to the ceiling joists
Tape and set the joins in three coats
Glue up the new cornice
Sand lightly, prime and paint

jobs.title: Fill the floor gap where the wall stood
Fit new skirting along the opening

inline.headline: Twelve halogens. One electrician visit.
inline.text: Snap each room's ceiling in Jib and it builds the list: how many downlights, which IC-4 fittings to buy, and what's left for you to patch and paint.
inline.alt: A dad photographing an old, yellowed halogen downlight in the living room ceiling with his phone while his daughter points out another one

jobs.title: Replace 12 halogen downlights with LED
jobs.description: Old 12 V halogens with transformers. Insulation going in next month.

shoppingList.item: IC-4 LED downlights, 90 mm cut-out, x12

directions: Count the downlights and note the cut-out size
Buy IC-4 rated LEDs with the same cut-out
Book a licensed electrician to swap them
Book the insulation for after the swap

end.headline: Better light, safer roof.
end.alt: A family reading together on the couch in the evening under warm, even downlights

jobs.title: Patch the old downlight holes
jobs.description: Four holes left after the electrician moved the lights.
directions: Check the electrician has made the cables safe
Fix backing strips and a plasterboard plug
Set, sand and set again
Prime and paint the patch

jobs.title: Check for leaves around the downlights

inline.headline: Tank first. Then the plumber's bit.
inline.text: Snap the side of the house in Jib and it plans the tank: the base, the screens and first flush, and a clear brief for the plumber to connect it.
inline.alt: A mum and her son reading the label on a new slimline rainwater tank that has just been delivered to their side yard

jobs.title: Install a 3,000 L slimline rainwater tank
jobs.description: Along the side fence, behind the building line. Toilet and laundry connection.
jobs.timeEstimate: About a day, plus the plumber

shoppingList.item: Crusher dust for the base, 1 m³
Plumber: connect to toilet and laundry

directions: Check council limits and the boundary distance
Level and compact the base
Fit the rain head, first flush and mosquito mesh
Book a licensed plumber for the house connection

jobs.title: Clean the gutters before the tank goes in
Connect the tank pump and backflow device

end.headline: Free water. A few easy checks.
end.alt: A girl filling a watering can from the tap on a rainwater tank beside the family veggie patch while her dad watches

jobs.title: Check the tank screens and first flush
jobs.description: Empty the first-flush diverter, check the mesh for holes, clear the rain head.
directions: Empty and rinse the first-flush diverter
Check the mosquito mesh on every opening
Clear leaves from the rain head
Look for pooling water around the tank
